blocks.text: Test tube mein thora toner dalein. Yaad rahe laser printer toner mein 40 % iron oxide nanometre size ke particles mein hota hai. Is mein khane ka tel dal kar chhari se achhi tarah milayein; ferrofluid ban jayega. Yeh fluid bottle mein dalein. Bottle hilane par fluid liquid ki tarah behta hai. Ab bottle ke bahar se magnet fluid ke qareeb layein.
Aap dekhenge ke fluid magnet ki taraf uchhalta hai, kyunke woh khud magnet ban gaya hai. Magnet ko bottle ki ek taraf pakray rakhein to fluid spikes wala structures bana leta hai (Fig. 10.18).

blocks.alt: Do tasveerein, ek ke neeche ek. Oopar: dhakkan wali sheeshe ki test tube, neeche tah mein gehra grey ferrofluid. Neeche: wahi tube, do haath us ke dono taraf chhote magnet pakre hue hain; fluid oopar uchhal kar un ke beech kaanton wali kaali shakal bana leta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.18: test tube mein ferrofluid, magnet ke baghair aur magnet ke saath (kitab ki Figure 10.18 ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wali tasveer mein magnet nahi, is liye ferrofluid aam liquid ki tarah tah mein para hai. Neeche magnet qareeb aate hi fluid khud magnet ban kar un ki taraf uchhalta hai aur field lines ke saath kaante bana leta hai.
